<observations>
Date: Apr 25, 2026
* 🔴 (12:15) User renovation budget is $28,000 for a house in Asheville, NC; user prefers quartz over marble for durability.
* ✅ (14:30) QuickRaze hired for demolition ($1,850); Cabinetry Creations custom cabinets and StoneEdge quartz countertops ordered.

Date: Apr 28, 2026
* ✅ (12:15) Harbor Plumbing booked for sink installation starting May 5; EcoStone Composite selected for 40-sq-ft backsplash.

Date: May 1, 2026
* ✅ (18:00) Electrical permit submitted for island 20-amp dedicated outlets; GranitePeak "Arctic White" quartz delivery set for May 7.
* 🔴 (19:00) User requested a quote for a matching stainless-steel dishwasher for the BrightHome 36-inch built-in refrigerator.

Date: May 4, 2026
* ✅ (13:00) Added pull-out pantry ($1,150) and TileMosaic subway tiles; under-cabinet LED strips selected and site visit scheduled for May 9.
* 🔴 (15:00) User stated preference for matte black cabinet hardware over brushed brass.

Date: May 8, 2026
* ✅ (15:15) Updated quartz selection to "Storm Cloud" pattern ($78/sq ft); booked plumber Carlos Ramos for May 15 faucet install.

Date: May 12, 2026
* ✅ (12:30) Ordered 450 sq ft matte ivory porcelain tiles from TileMasters (delivery May 20-22).
* ✅ (18:05) Approved CabinetCraft walnut island cabinets ($4,200) for installation week of May 25; electrician confirmed as Dale Okonkwo.
</observations>

<current-task>
- Primary: Provide a quote for a matching stainless-steel dishwasher to go with the BrightHome refrigerator.
- Secondary: Track ongoing kitchen renovation milestones (site visit May 9, faucet install May 15, cabinet install week of May 25).
</current-task>

<suggested-response>
Would you like me to look up a quote for a matching stainless-steel dishwasher to go with your BrightHome refrigerator?
</suggested-response>
